concept.title: Additive access
concept.shortdesc: User access on the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console uses an additive model, which means that there are no deny roles. In other words, actions are only permitted.

conbody.p: To control access, assign the appropriate roles with the desired permissions to groups, then add users to those groups. The access permitted to any individual user is a sum of all roles assigned to all groups to which that user belongs.
